steps.subject: sky
steps.action: mix black and blue for the top
steps.motion: x-shaped strokes from the top down

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the color down so it lightens toward the horizon
steps.load: paint mixes with white on the canvas
steps.rule: color lightens toward the horizon as it mixes with white

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add black and blue water across the bottom
steps.motion: start at the outside edge and pull inward
steps.rule: starting at the edge avoids a hard line that is hard to blend

steps.subject: water
steps.action: blend the bottom and leave a light sheen open
steps.motion: blend lightly, leave a light area open
steps.rule: a light opening becomes a sheen of light

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap titanium white on the fan brush for clouds
steps.load: load both sides of the fan

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tiny circles to shape the white cloud
steps.rule: do not stay in one spot or it looks like a cotton ball

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the cloud with the top bristles of a dry 2in
steps.motion: pull the top bristles lightly over the cloud
steps.rule: only thick dry paint blends this way, so keep it dry

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: fluff the layered cloud edges

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: mix gray on a fan brush for darker layers

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend layer bottoms back and fluff the top
steps.motion: dry brush blends the base back

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: let a small cloud slip down as a front floater
steps.load: gray and white on the brush

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the cloud bases and the sky together
steps.motion: clean dry brush blends the base out

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add a basic mountain with black and blue
steps.load: dark gray mix on the fan
steps.motion: drop in peaks that fade out

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull mountain color across the wet canvas
steps.rule: a wet canvas lets the color move

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add titanium white snow on the mountain tops
steps.motion: rub, turning the knife to widen down the mountain
steps.rule: keep the dark areas, they become shadows

steps.subject: other: trees
steps.action: tap gray for little trees growing up the mountain side

steps.subject: other: trees
steps.action: lift up tiny far trees with a clean dry 1in

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add another tree layer with snow at the base
steps.motion: add a small layer and snow at the base
steps.rule: snow at the base brings it together

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap far evergreens with a fan brush
steps.rule: not too dark, since several layers will follow

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap the base with a clean 2in to create mist
steps.rule: mist makes the winter scene feel colder

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: push up grassy things at the base

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: push harder down the tree from the corner
steps.motion: push harder moving down the tree

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull dark color through a white brush for shadow
steps.load: white with a pull of dark
steps.motion: pull down a little dark area

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: fill in snow with angled strokes

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull dark straight down for a pond
steps.rule: a pull creates a sheen on the pond

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a water line with thinned white
steps.load: liquid white thinned with titanium white
steps.motion: cut a line like a hole

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull titanium white straight through the lake
steps.rule: pulling pushes the lake area back

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap a small evergreen with fan blue-black

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: pull a shadow under the evergreen
steps.motion: pull the bottom for a shadow

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap an evergreen on the other side
steps.motion: tap the tree from the corner

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: bend the little evergreen over

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull a 2in straight down for reflections

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: darker tree in front with stronger values
steps.rule: darker values in front make it stand out

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a liquid white water line by the tree

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add a sheen ripple and scrape in sticks
